# Leave the compressed section holding the card updater stock

On the OM-5 Mark II the card updater is in compressed section 7; repacking it puts recovery at risk.

**Category:** hazard · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om5-ii firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om5-ii-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md)

Preserve the stored span at main-payload offset 0xc9d7e0, and preferably section 6 too. This is the project's inference: no failure has been traced to it.

> **What happens:** If section 7 fails to load, the card updater may not run to restore stock.

**Symptoms:** [Firmware update or recovery at risk](index.md#recovery-at-risk)

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Caduceus for OM-5](../projects/caduceus-om5.md)): FIRMUP_CLI is inside section 7; the builder can preserve the stored spans. Source: [OM-5 Mark II stock section 7](../sources/om5.section7.md).

**[Full detail upstream](https://github.com/xulfr/caduceus-om5/blob/a72851a4ada5eab8eed02f7a06afd7f9297bbe81/research/OM5II-STOCK-SECTION7.md#build-boundary)**
